capabilities: create daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly and yearly notes automatically in the background
open and pin new periodic notes in tabs
exclude weekends from daily note creation
commit and push the vault to git at the end of each day
extras: The git commit-and-push feature is desktop-only, off by default, and runs only between 18:00 and 18:05 local time; the rest of the plugin works on mobile.
intentEvidence: When the Periodic Notes plugin is installed, this plugin respects its settings, creating your notes using the templates, format and location
problem: Obsidian's periodic note features only create a note when you trigger it, so you must remember to make each day's, week's or month's note yourself.

relations.evidence: When the Periodic Notes plugin is installed, this plugin respects its settings
or your Calendar plugin settings, if you have it

summary: Automation plugin that creates daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly and yearly notes in the background, optionally opening, pinning and closing them.
